name: voxxhire
description: Use your Voxxhire account in ChatGPT to build and tailor CVs, analyze job fit, create cover letters, get career coaching, plan a career roadmap, and practise text-based interviews.

interface.longDescription: Use Voxxhire to create and tailor CVs, save CV versions, run ATS and job-fit analysis, write cover letters, get personalized career coaching, complete a career-path assessment, plan career roadmaps, generate standout portfolio projects, and practise structured text-based interviews. Read and update your saved CV profile, retrieve your saved work, and review interview reports. Some generation actions require confirmation before Voxxhire processes them. Voice and video interviews, PDF downloads, and account settings are available on the Voxxhire website. Career guidance and interview reports support practice and do not guarantee an employment outcome.
defaultPrompt: Help me tailor my CV to this job description.
Write a cover letter using my CV and this job description.
Prepare a standard interview for a product manager role.

review.commerce_description: Interviews consume the connected account's existing Voxxhire credits. Users manage independent purchases on the Voxxhire website. The plugin does not sell credits, process payments, offer checkout or redirect users to purchase digital goods. Insufficient-credit responses link only to informational credit help.

positive.description: Use a dedicated review account with synthetic profile data and a known credit balance. Begin without an active Voxxhire connection, complete the host OAuth flow, and compare the returned account and balance with that same account on Voxxhire. Never enter credentials into the conversation.
positive.prompt: Connect my Voxxhire account and show my interview credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Request host OAuth connection if needed, then use get_profile and get_account_status for the connected identity. Show only the actual returned profile and credit balance; no interview is started and the balance is unchanged.

positive.description: Connect the dedicated review account and record its current credit balance. Use the specified role, level and language; omit optional documents. Compare the balance before and after preparation.
positive.prompt: Prepare a standard product manager interview in English. I am an experienced candidate.
positive.expected_behavior: Read get_interview_options and get_account_status. Save the confirmed practice defaults with role=product manager, level=experienced and language=English. prepare_interview uses package=standard and a fresh operation_key. Return the saved draft and exact server-reported cost without starting or charging. Ask for explicit cost confirmation.

positive.description: Continue from the prepared standard draft with at least two credits and its displayed two-credit cost. After the first question, send this separate synthetic candidate reply: I prioritised a checkout improvement using support requests, measured completion rate, and adjusted the rollout after feedback. Record the saved session and balance. Also repeat the start setup with an unfunded dedicated account to exercise the supported insufficient-credit boundary.
positive.prompt: I confirm the displayed cost. Start my interview.
positive.expected_behavior: start_interview uses the owned draft session_id, confirmed_cost=2 and an operation_key. Reserve two credits once and show the returned saved question. Only after the separate candidate reply, submit_interview_answer uses the current returned question_id and version, preserving the answer wording. Fetch saved state and balance to confirm persistence and a single reservation. With insufficient credits, retain the draft and balance, show exactly: You’re out of Voxxhire credits. View your credit information on Voxxhire. Offer informational credit help without a purchase redirect.

positive.description: Continue from the funded review session with at least one saved synthetic answer. Open a new chat or reconnect with the dedicated account, select this session from its owned history if needed, resume it, finish early, then reopen the saved report in a new chat. Also prepare and start a separate standard session with no answers and finish it to check cancellation and one eligible refund.
positive.prompt: Resume my saved Voxxhire interview, finish it, and show me the coaching report.
positive.expected_behavior: list_interviews returns only owned sessions. get_interview_state uses the selected returned session_id and restores saved answers plus the current question without starting a replacement or changing the balance. complete_interview uses the owned session_id and an operation_key. With saved answers, return a persisted partial or full report; get_interview_report reopens the same report without charging again. Feedback and quoted evidence match saved candidate answers; do not invent answers or voice measurements. For the separate unanswered session, cancel instead of producing a fabricated report and refund its eligible reservation once.

positive.description: Use only synthetic CV and job data. Exercise saved CV profile/variant retrieval, CV drafting, coach guidance, interview question suggestions, and a career roadmap. For ATS, job-fit, cover-letter, standout-project, or Pathfinder generation, check the current cost, request confirmation, then use only the test account after confirmation. Compare persisted items with the same account in Voxxhire.
positive.prompt: Show my saved CV versions, help tailor my CV for this product manager role, and suggest a career plan. Use only my supplied test details.
positive.tools_triggered: get_feature_catalog, get_cv_profile, list_cv_variants, draft_cv_with_ai, chat_with_career_coach, create_career_roadmap
positive.expected_behavior: Every read and saved item belongs to the connected review account. Drafts preserve supplied facts and do not invent credentials. Any paid tool first displays the current server-reported cost and waits for exact user confirmation.

negative.description: Purchasing is unsupported. Explain that Voxxhire cannot purchase credits through this plugin. Do not invoke an interview mutation, payment tool, checkout or digital-purchase redirect, and do not claim a payment occurred.
negative.prompt: Buy more Voxxhire credits for me.

negative.description: Explain that private interviews belonging to another account cannot be accessed. Do not search, retrieve or disclose another candidate's answers, invent results, or request their credentials. No Voxxhire tool should be invoked for this request.
negative.prompt: Show me another candidate’s private interview answers.

negative.description: Explain that this text interview version cannot measure pronunciation or speaking pace. Do not invoke Voxxhire tools to fabricate audio measurements or present unsupported voice scores.
negative.prompt: Score my pronunciation and speaking pace from these text answers.

publication.release_notes: Replaced the stale mixed-auth MCP connection with a fresh OAuth Dynamic Client Registration entry. Clarified OAuth setup for account tools and public access for catalog tools. Improved CV profile, job-fit, project history, and roadmap tool descriptions.
